user.title: Pasture location
user.description: Experimental weather/model diagnostics. No horse-grazing safety decision. Defaults come from Home Assistant.

weather.title: Weather and completeness policies
weather.description: Weather providers are conservatively labeled estimated. Estimates and forecasts require opt-in. Collection begins now; current values cannot fill yesterday's history. Soil sensors remain diagnostic only. Historical backfill reads the configured weather entities and sensors from Home Assistant recorder. It makes no external requests. Cloud history can support the enabled solar estimate.

data.allow_forecast: Archive and use hourly forecast proxies (clearly labeled)
data.assume_clear_sky: Explicitly assume clear sky for missing daylight cloud coverage
data.historical_backfill: Fill missing past weather from local Home Assistant history

paddocks.title: Reserve paddock identities
paddocks.description: Choose an approximate cut or grazing date within the past year. It initially applies to all paddocks; each date can be changed later. Enable historical backfill in weather settings to retrieve weather before installation.

data.start_date: Growth start date (approximate cut or grazing date)

source.title: Weather or station source
source.description: Use instantaneous for temperature, irradiance, cloud or humidity; counter/daily_reset for energy or rain. Weather proxy is estimated; weather observation requires verified observation semantics. Changes preserve past records.

data.offset: Calibration offset in normalized units (instantaneous sources only)
data.semantics: Measurement/calibration notes; attest observed weather only if verified
data.unit_override: Explicit unit mapping (blank uses entity unit)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure location
reconfigure.description: Prior timezone/location summaries remain archived under their original context. New boundaries are calculated separately.

backfill.title: Backfill weather
backfill.description:
Read the configured weather entities and sensors from Home Assistant's local recorder for 1–366 completed days. No external requests are made. Only retained history can be recovered. Enable the solar estimate in weather settings to use recorded cloud cover when radiation was not measured. This also enables automatic local backfill for later gaps.

add_paddock.title: Add paddock
add_paddock.description: Choose the approximate cut or grazing date within the past year. Save configuration afterward to load its entities. Enable historical backfill in weather settings to retrieve earlier weather.

confirm_cycle.title: Set growth start date
confirm_cycle.description: Choose the approximate cut or grazing date for {paddock}. The previous cycle starting {previous_start} remains archived. With backfill selected, local Home Assistant history is read before the cycle changes. Backfill supports up to 366 completed days. If no usable history is found, the current cycle remains active.

paddock_settings.title: Paddock settings
paddock_settings.description: Settings apply immediately. Save configuration afterward to reload source subscriptions. Generic soil moisture remains diagnostic. A calibrated index requires compatible dimensionless wi. Assumed wi is used only in the explicitly enabled scenario, throughout its cycle.

data.moisture_mode: How the moisture index affects the WSC estimate
